verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm offering legal services plus free resources such as LathamDrive document generators and the Book of Jargon glossary. It does not offer user-authored automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. The document generators (including the Automated Convertible Note) produce legal documents; they are not user-managed automation workflows, so they do not make this axis applicable.
